title: Move-In Concession and Rent Discount Program Rates — Apartment Home Lease Floor Plans
content:
Revenue management sets, per Apartment Home Lease floor plan, the move-in concession offered on the floor plan and the rates of the two monthly rent discount programs, the preferred employer program and the active military program.

## Rate table

| Floor plan | Move-in concession (weeks of free base rent) | Minimum initial lease term for the concession | Preferred employer discount rate (share of monthly rent) | Active military discount per month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 4 | 12 months | 0.05 (5%) | $50.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 2 | 12 months | 0.05 (5%) | $50.00 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 0 (none) | 12 months | 0.05 (5%) | $50.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 3 | 12 months | 0.03 (3%) | $75.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 6 | 13 months | 0.03 (3%) | $75.00 |
| Penthouse Residence | 0 (none) | 12 months | 0.00 (0%) | $0.00 |

## Definitions

- **Move-in concession** — the weeks of free base rent offered as a move-in concession on the floor plan; 0 means the floor plan offers none.
- **Minimum initial lease term** — the minimum months of the initial lease term required to receive the move-in concession.
- **Preferred employer discount rate** — the floor plan's monthly base rent discount rate for the preferred employer program, stated as a decimal fraction of monthly rent.
- **Active military discount** — the floor plan's monthly base rent discount for the active military program, in dollars per month.

## Notes

1. The One-Bedroom Den Residence and the Penthouse Residence carry no move-in concession; a minimum term is still listed for them but has nothing to unlock.
2. The Three-Bedroom Residence is the only floor plan whose concession requires an initial term of 13 months rather than 12.
3. The Penthouse Residence carries a preferred employer rate of 0.00 and an active military discount of $0.00.
4. The preferred employer rate is 0.05 on the Studio, One-Bedroom and One-Bedroom Den Residences and 0.03 on the Two-Bedroom and Three-Bedroom Residences.
